title: oenothera andina var. hilgardii
intro: Oenothera andina var. hilgardii, commonly known as Evening Primrose, is a species of flowering plant in the family Onagraceae. It is native to the Andes Mountains in South America, and its roots and leaves have been traditionally used in folk medicine for their health benefits. The plant is rich in omega-6 fatty acids, particularly gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), which has been shown to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it beneficial for skin and joint health. The bioactive constituents of Evening Primrose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antihistaminic effects.
